jobs.title: Director, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
jobs.description:
Questrade Financial Group (QFG)
, through its companies - Questrade, Questbank, Questrade Wealth Management, Community Trust Company, Zolo, and Flexiti, provides securities and foreign currency investment, professionally managed investment portfolios, mortgages, real estate services, financial services and more. We use cutting-edge technology to help Canadians become much more financially successful and secure.

At QFG, we combine human-centric collaboration with AI-driven innovation to redefine financial services. The ideal candidate will be a catalyst for change, using AI to transform and deliver unparalleled customer experiences and shaping a future where AI empowers our teams to do their best work.

Join our diverse, inclusive, and hybrid workplace to unleash your creativity and nurture your curiosity without limits. If you share this sense of infinite possibility, come shape your future at QFG.

What’s in it for you as an employee of QFG?

Health & wellbeing resources and programs
Paid vacation, personal, and sick days for work-life balance
Competitive compensation and benefits packages
Work-life balance in a hybrid environment with at least 3 days in office
Career growth and development opportunities
Opportunities to contribute to community causes
Work with diverse team members in an inclusive and collaborative environment

This job posting is for an existing vacancy

We’re looking for our next Director, FP&A. Could It Be You?

The Director, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) is a key leadership role within the Finance team, designed to deliver insightful financial information and strategic analysis to the Executive Team and Board of Directors. Contributing directly to the success of Questbank and Questrade Financial Group, this role leads the business case and investment process, budget and forecast functions, and comprehensive management reporting. The Director plays a pivotal role in tracking headcount investments and overall financial performance while leading precise, fact-based upfront analysis for upwards of $100MM in new yearly initiatives, ensuring alignment with both short- and long-term corporate strategic objectives.

Need more details? Keep reading…

In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Leading the development, monitoring, and reporting for all business cases within the organization. Oversee precise and fact-based upfront analysis, ongoing monitoring, and reporting to the executive team for upwards of $100MM in new initiatives annually to ensure success.
Directing and driving the preparation and consolidation of the annual budget and monthly rolling forecasts. Collaborate closely with division leaders to ensure all assumptions are tested and vetted properly, ownership exists at the division level, and consensus is gained to align on organizational goals.
Leading the comprehensive monthly review of consolidated financials against the budget. Provide in-depth analysis to division leaders and the executive team focusing on KPIs, key ratios, and delivering value-added commentary on next steps to keep the company on track for its long-term strategic goals.
Driving rigorous financial modeling for all acquisitions and special projects. Work closely with corporate development to ensure detailed and accurate models covering organic growth, acquisition-related growth, integration economics, income statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and covenants, enabling Senior Management to make informed decisions.
Being responsible for all management reporting to division leads, the executive team, and the board (including Management Reports, Journey Reports, business KPIs, key ratios, corporate scorecards, and MD&A) against the budget, forecast, prior year, prior month, and the 5-year plan. Ensure consistency across corporate and business unit reporting.
Serving as the primary FP&A system lead, driving continuous improvement and automation in financial processes, reporting frameworks, and data integrity.
Partnering with senior leadership, Treasury, and Risk Management to ensure financial reporting consistency, liquidity tracking, and holistic strategic decision-making support.
Structuring, managing, and mentoring the FP&A team to align with corporate requirements. Set clear performance objectives, provide regular feedback, and foster a high-performance culture.

So are YOU our next Director, FP&A? You are if you…

Have a Post-secondary degree/diploma in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field.
Have a completed CPA or equivalent accounting designation
Have 10+ years of experience in the financial industry
Have 5+ years of experience in a similar FP&A role
Have 5+ years in a management role
Have advanced financial modeling, budgeting and analytical skills.

Additional Kudos If You…

Have experience in financial services, wealth management, or banking (highly beneficial for Questbank).
Have experience with enterprise FP&A and ERP systems such as NetSuite or Oracle EPBCS (Hyperion)

Sounds like you? Click below to apply!

At Questrade Financial Group of Companies, with multiple office locations around the world, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and accessible work environment. This is an environment where individuals are treated with dignity and respect. Here, the unique skills and experience you bring will be valued. You will be supported and motivated, so that you can harness your unlimited potential. Our team reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and operate in. Having a collaborative and diverse team helps us push boundaries to bring the future of fintech into existence—not only for the benefit of our customers, but for those who build their career with us.

Questrade Financial Group of companies Applicant Tracking System utilizes artificial intelligence (AI) for application screening. The AI system operates on predetermined criteria, with final decisions subject to human review.

Candidates selected for an interview will be contacted directly. If you require accommodation during the recruitment/selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Not Applicable

jobs.title: Director, Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
Company Description

For 100 years, Reitmans (Canada) Limited (RCL) has defined the Canadian retail fashion landscape with its three iconic brands, Reitmans, RW&CO. and PENN. Penningtons. We're excited about what we’ll build together next. 

Our vision is to empower Canadians to live confidently, and our mission is to create collections of uncompromising style and quality for all.

We believe great people do their best work alongside other great people. Here, you’ll have a voice, be challenged to grow and be part of a team driven by curiosity, bold thinking and ownership.

Come raise the bar of Canadian fashion with us.

Job Description

The Director, Data & Analytics leads the development and execution of RCL’s data and analytics strategy, enabling actionable insights to enhance customer engagement and overall business performance. The Director will champion a data-driven culture by ensuring accurate and consistent digital and ecommerce measurement, developing meaningful performance frameworks, and leveraging advanced analytics, experimentation, and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for growth and optimization.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the enterprise Data & Analytics strategy and roadmap, establishing a clear vision, priorities, and multi-year roadmap for data, analytics, and AI capabilities aligned to RCL’s broader business strategy and growth objectives
Develop the organization’s data and AI maturity, fostering data literacy, enabling self-service analytics where appropriate, and building a culture in which teams across the enterprise use data and AI confidently and responsibly to inform decisions
Enable trusted, actionable business insights by establishing consistent metrics, reporting frameworks, dashboards, and analytical methodologies that enable leaders to understand performance and make informed decisions
Build excellent partnerships with leaders across the Digital, eComm, Retail, Merchandising, Marketing and Finance teams, to identify opportunities where data and analytics can improve customer experience, profitability, and operational performance
Strengthen digital and ecommerce analytics accuracy, ensuring robust measurement, tagging, tracking, attribution, and data quality across digital channels and ecommerce platforms to provide a reliable view of customer behaviour, channel performance, conversion, and the overall digital customer journey
Improve marketing and channel measurement, developing sophisticated approaches to attribution, incrementality, customer acquisition, retention, media effectiveness, and ROI to optimize investment across channels
Develop predictive and advanced analytics capabilities, including forecasting, segmentation, propensity modelling, experimentation, and AI/ML use cases that generate measurable business value
Translate complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations, effectively communicating insights and implications to executive and non-technical audiences
Establish enterprise-wide data governance and standards across RCL, including data definitions, quality standards, ownership, stewardship, accessibility, privacy, and governance practices that ensure data is trusted, consistent, secure, and fit for purpose across brands and functions.
Partner with Technology on data architecture and platforms, helping define the enterprise data ecosystem, architecture, platforms, infrastructure, and tooling required to enable scalable analytics, AI, reporting, and business intelligence capabilities
Build a high-performing analytics function, developing talent, ways of working, governance, and capabilities that enable the organization to become increasingly data-driven.
Champion a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement, using analytics, testing, and evidence-based learning to identify what works, scale successful initiatives, and improve business outcomes
Stay ahead of emerging technologies and methodology in data science and AI to bring the best innovation to RCL

Qualifications

10+ years of demonstrated experience in advanced analytics, data science and/or data engineering, preferably in retail, with at least 3 years in a leadership role
Bachelors degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering or Mathematics. MBA or equivalent experience preferred
Proven ability and experience leading teams to analyze customer data for actionable business insight
Strong SQL skills for querying relational databases
Deep expertise in Google Analytics and web analytics implementation
Experience using and implementing visualization tools like Tableau, MicroStrategy or Power BI
Experience with common machine learning libraries in R, Python, Spark is an asset
Strong critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills, and excellent attention to detail
Strong balance between the science of analytics, and the storytelling required to appropriately interpret business insights: skilled at turning complex analysis into simple conclusions and recommendations
Technical data science & analytics leadership: ability and desire to coach the team to build technical skills

Additional Information

What Sets Us Apart:

Ultimate Flexibility*: Enjoy a hybrid work environment that ensures the perfect balance between work and personal life.
Well-Being First: Access a comprehensive benefits program designed to take care of you.
Flexible Time Off*: Paid leave, sick days, and vacation time to recharge and spend quality time with loved ones.
Exclusive Discounts*: Enjoy 50% off regular-priced items from PENN. Penningtons, Reitmans, and RW&CO.
Referral Rewards*: Refer your professional network and earn a bonus for helping us grow our talented team
Growth opportunities*: Annual bonuses, career advancement, and tuition reimbursement to help you reach your professional goals.
Certain conditions apply

Total rewards are aligned with your employment status, offering different perks depending on whether you're full-time, part-time, or under contract.

Reitmans (Canada) Limited is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace where everyone belongs. If you are contacted for an employment opportunity, please advise us of any accommodation required throughout the recruitment process. All information provided will be kept confidential and used solely to support an accessible candidate's experience.

The use of Artificial Intelligence may be used for candidate screening purposes.

We thank all applicants. Only selected candidates will be contacted.
